children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' game where children mimic the hip movements of the instructor.

seniors.seated_version: Perform hip rotations and arm movements while seated in a sturdy chair.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the hip sway while holding onto a chair for balance.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and smaller range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Fluid, expressive movements, often used to balance the hip rotation.
movement_profile.footwork: Shuffling steps that never leave the ground.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couples or groups moving in circular paths.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: The primary focus; hips move in circular and side-to-side motions.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Dancers may lower their bodies towards the floor while continuing to move the upper body.
movement_profile.partnering: Playful, non-contact or light-contact interaction where the woman leads the direction.
movement_profile.posture: Upright but relaxed, with knees slightly bent to facilitate hip movement.

signature_moves.description: Fluid, rhythmic circular movement of the hips while feet remain grounded.
signature_moves.name: Hip Rotation

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Varies from moderate to very fast (in Rodrigues).
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Lifting the feet off the ground.

music_profile.sound_description: A percussive, drum-heavy sound driven by the deep resonance of the ravanne and the metallic shimmer of the triangle, often featuring call-and-response vocals.

basic_steps: Keep feet in contact with the floor at all times.
Shift weight from side to side to initiate hip movement.
Rotate hips in a fluid, circular motion.
Maintain a playful, improvisational connection with a partner.
teaching.formation: Couples or groups in circular formations
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on maintaining grounded footwork while isolating hip movement from the upper body.
